details: No trustworthy LuAG-specific full photoelastic tensor was located in the searched sources. Do not silently substitute YAG values.
simulation_impact: Required only for stress-induced birefringence / depolarization modeling. Scalar dn/dT and surface deformation can still be modeled.
recommended_action: Obtain experimental LuAG p_ij or explicitly run a sensitivity study using a clearly labeled proxy.

details: Room-temperature k versus doping is available; undoped LuAG k(T) is measured mainly up to 300 K.
simulation_impact: Important if disk locally exceeds 300 K.
recommended_action: Use sample-specific measurement or a clearly labeled extrapolation; package helper refuses extrapolation by default.

details: Körner 2012 provides the curves graphically; accessible article page did not expose machine-readable arrays.
simulation_impact: Relevant for high-fidelity line-by-line gain simulation.
recommended_action: Current NPZ/CSV export is an engineering reconstruction from published figures and scalar anchors; replace with author data if obtained.

details: Host LuAG Sellmeier is available; a general high-precision n(lambda,cYb) relation was not located.
simulation_impact: Usually secondary for 5-15 at.% Yb but can matter in precision phase models.
recommended_action: Treat host dispersion as baseline and calibrate with measured sample n/ellipsometry when available.

details: Room-temperature LuAG Cij are available; a robust LuAG Cij(T) set over thin-disk operating temperatures was not located.
simulation_impact: Second-order for moderate temperature excursions, more important for large gradients.
recommended_action: Use room-temperature tensor initially; add uncertainty/sensitivity analysis.
